# Delane

> Poet, author and mental-health advocate from Mississippi. Her work centers on mental health, faith, identity, healing and self-worth. She shares her poetry through spoken-word performances and digital platforms, where she has a community of more than 70,000 followers across her social media platforms.

## Work
- Poetry books:
  - You Don't Have to Die to Matter: Poems for Healing: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GCRPN6RP
  - The Kitchen Doesn't Stay Clean for Long: A Book of Poems: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G9SQY6N9
  - The Lane's Heart Vol. 1: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FNJJ4NWY
- Available for speaking engagements, poetry performances, school visits, literary events, podcast interviews and virtual events
- Especially interested in working with students and young adults on poetry, mental health and creative expression
